title: Dutch hospital quarantines staff amid hantavirus outbreak concern
desc: Health authorities in the Netherlands have quarantined 12 hospital staff members after potential exposure to hantavirus, following strict precautionary measures. The decision came after concerns that medical workers at Radboud University Medical Center in Nijmegen may have handled infected samples without fully adequate safety protocols, prompting immediate containment steps.
